# E04-T16 review-6 accident witnesses

Authority: committed review-6 at edi `4db4b74` / crysta `76908333`, owner fit-state decision
`1038779f6`. These add user outcome witnesses; the earlier scoped consumer checks remain.

| Class | Ordinary accident first | Observed outcome and independent reference |
| --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | Switch datasets, immediately Fit, edit a value/free flag/iteration cap, Reset, Undo Reset, or Save As before its read finishes. | A semaphore holds the real installed SDK reader. The action reaches that pending state. Optimizer entry receives the independently hashed selected measured columns; newer admitted scalar/flag/settings and restored/cleared result facts survive delivery. A refused pending action is allowed; a subsequently settled Fit still reaches the intended file. |
| R2 | Scan, single-fit a dataset, Undo, save/reopen; or Reset after that single fit and Undo once. | Round-trip all parameters, dataset outcomes, template designation, held result, summary kind/time and stale marks, alongside all three output files. Reset clears every fit fact while preserving template values. |
| R2 output boundary | Storage becomes unavailable during Reset or Undo and stays unavailable during rollback. | Transparent libc mutation wrappers fail each of the three actual output addresses. Every pre-existing payload must remain durably recoverable somewhere in the project and the refusal must be visible. No backup filename or transaction implementation is prescribed. |
| R5 | Stop after one dataset, change a template value, free flag or fit setting, Continue, Save As/reopen, Reset/Undo, then Reset and run fully. | The retained prefix bytes survive; old rows stay visibly out of date live, reopened and restored by Undo. Only replacement by a complete fresh generation clears the warning. |
| R8 | Wheel zoom during a scan; its next rows and terminal reload arrive. | Actual Qt window, production Evolution item, real wheel event and worker callbacks: plotted axis bounds retain the viewport until an explicit reset or parameter/axis choice. |
| R8 gesture edges | Right-reset over another point, drag horizontally/vertically or near a point, or left-click a point. | Actual pointer events preserve selection for reset/drag, reject zero-span boxes, retain finite positive plotted bounds, and accept a normal left point click. Diagonal bounds use closed-form pixel-to-data conversion. |
| R9 | Enter a finite step below one double ULP at a finite starting offset, then Save. | Both axes in edi's edit/save route and crysta's declared-range load/save route must refuse collapse or keep strictly increasing representable points through reopening. Ordinary ranges are positive controls; expected points and collapse come from IEEE spacing. |
| R3/R7 | Open a scan after a damaged results write, a corrupted/type-invalid run summary, or copying results from a different directory. | A visible named refusal and no accidental Start/replacement; explicit Reset is the recovery action. A changed indexed numeric cell cannot silently project template values as fitted data. |
| R4 | Change the iteration limit after results already exist. | The previous displayed producing outcomes remain invariant; the edit does not refit or change CSV bytes. Legacy reasons may be unavailable, never guessed from today's setting. |
| R6 | Open a fitted scan without selecting its other datasets. | Native input observations allow the shown payload and at most four upcoming addresses; generating a digest cannot eagerly read later payloads. This small accident witness is not the full 100000-file benchmark. |

Synthetic fitted CSV values, uncertainties, temperatures and file identities are declared by the visible
input producer. Scientific correctness is not claimed from the fitted app output. Transaction and provenance
checks use round-trip and generation invariants. Native object symbol wrappers call the installed original
reader/optimizer bodies; they delay or observe entries without replacing numeric work or the driver loop.

A free-flag edit can change the CSV's declared fitted columns. Continue may visibly refuse that
incompatible schema; the attempt must preserve the old prefix and its old-generation warning in this
case too. Value and iteration-setting edits keep their columns and must finish the missing datasets.
